summary_en: Annual dividend raised from ¥80/share to ¥105/share (31.3% increase), comprising ordinary dividend of ¥105 (vs prior ¥80) paid as single year-end distribution. Increase follows upward revision of FY8/12 earnings; management targeting 30%+ payout ratio and progressive dividend policy.
title_en: Notification of upward revision of earnings forecast and modification of dividend forecast (dividend increase) for FY8/12
translation_en_brief:
Taki Chemical revised its FY8/12 (calendar 2024) earnings forecast upward and increased the annual dividend forecast. The company reported higher-than-expected sales and profitability driven by increased feedstock costs and resulting demand surge in the agri-chemicals business, plus price correction in water treatment chemicals. Net profit forecast was raised from ¥2,650M to ¥3,500M (+32.1%).

The dividend forecast was increased from ¥80/share to ¥105/share (31.3% hike), payable as a single year-end distribution. The company targets a 30%+ payout ratio and follows a progressive dividend policy balancing shareholder returns with investment in growth strategy, R&D, and capital efficiency. Formal approval at the 108th Annual General Meeting is pending (scheduled March 2025).
